# 1 Enoch Chapter 91 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**91:1** And-now, my-son Methuselah, call to-me all thy-brothers and-gather together to-me all the-sons of-thy-mother; for-the-word calls-me, and-the-spirit is-poured-out upon-me, that-I-may show you everything that-shall-befall you for-ever.

**91:2** And-thereupon Methuselah went and-summoned to-him all his-brothers and-assembled his-relatives.

**91:3** And-he-spoke unto all the-children of-righteousness and-said: 'Hear, ye-sons of-Enoch, all the-words of-your-father, and-hearken aright to-the-voice of-my-mouth; for-I-exhort you and-say unto-you, beloved: Love-uprightness and-walk therein.

**91:4** And-draw-not nigh to-uprightness with-a-double heart, and-associate not with-those of-a-double heart, but-walk in-righteousness, my-sons. And-it shall-guide you on-good paths, and-righteousness shall-be your-companion.
